title: On Feeding the pigs twice a day
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：feed　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 feed 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the tailor ① fed the pigs twice a day before dawn, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② feeds the pigs twice a day in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ feed the pigs twice a day at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fed the pigs twice a day before — a line in the order for November 1968 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Feeding the pigs twice a day before dawn, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ feed four mouths on one wage in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Feed four mouths on one wage at once and never mention it again.

By 1981 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ feeds four mouths on one wage before dawn every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fed the pigs twice a day again when nobody else would.

⑩ To feed the pigs twice a day, my mother said in 1986, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody feeds the pigs twice a day in public again and somebody must feed the pigs twice a day before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 喂养（一般过去式 fed the pigs twice a day：1974 年裁缝头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 喂养（一般现在 feeds the pigs twice a day：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 喂养（不定式 to feed the pigs twice a day：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 喂养（过去完成时 had fed the pigs twice a day：1968 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 喂养（动名词 feeding the pigs twice a day 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 供养（feed four mouths on one wage：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去供养靠一份工钱养活四张嘴）
G. v. 供养（feed four mouths on one wage：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 喂养（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 feeds four mouths on one wage，而母亲又一次 fed the pigs twice a day）

answers.why: feed 意为“喂养”，1974 年裁缝天没亮就喂养一天两回喂猪，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 fed。
feed 意为“喂养”，自那以后裁缝当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 feeds。
feed 意为“喂养”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯喂养一天两回喂猪”，此处为不定式 to feed the pigs twice a day。
feed 意为“喂养”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1981 年之前就有人喂养过，故用过去完成时 had fed。
feed 意为“喂养”，裁缝说“喂养一天两回喂猪这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 feeding the pigs twice a day 作主语。
feed 意为“供养”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去供养靠一份工钱养活四张嘴”，should ever 之后用原形 feed four mouths on one wage。
feed 意为“供养”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻供养靠一份工钱养活四张嘴（feed four mouths on one wage at once），以后再也不要提起。
feed 意为“喂养”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例供养靠一份工钱养活四张嘴，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 feeds。
feed 意为“喂养”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就喂养一天两回喂猪，用一般过去式 fed 叙述。
feed 意为“喂养”，结尾那句是母亲 1986 年的话：要喂养一天两回喂猪，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 feed 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the tailor fed the pigs twice a day before dawn, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor feeds the pigs twice a day in public whenever the shop asks.
Feeding the pigs twice a day before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever feed four mouths on one wage in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop feeds four mouths on one wage before dawn every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother fed the pigs twice a day again, and the shop remembered that half.
